svg.title: Solved tasks, run by run
svg.desc: Which Terminal-Bench 2.0 tasks were solved in each of five runs of the Assignment 5 agent: three leaderboard gradings (Board 1 33, Board 2 28, Board 3 30 of 89) and two local runs (Local 1 27, Local 2 28 of 89). 14 tasks were solved in all five runs, 30 in one to four of them, and 45 in none (not shown).
svg.text: 45 tasks were not solved in any run and are not shown. Each column is one task.
Board 1 and Local 1 ran the same agent; the other runs added small changes.
